description: Self-contained molecular identity for the two PyDIG photoisomers and their conjugate-acid states. Atom maps are stable within each record; E/Z labels refer to the two imine geometries adjacent to the central guanidine.

molecules.label: E,E-PyDIG neutral base
molecules.protonation: neutral PyDIG; two equivalent terminal imine NH sites are deprotonated relative to the conjugate acid
molecules.stereochemistry: E,E at both pyridylmethylene C=N bonds
molecules.atom_map: Map atoms from left pyridine through left imine, central guanidine, right imine, right pyridine in SMILES order.

molecules.label: Z,Z-PyDIG neutral base
molecules.protonation: neutral PyDIG; two equivalent terminal imine NH sites are deprotonated relative to the conjugate acid
molecules.stereochemistry: Z,Z at both pyridylmethylene C=N bonds
molecules.atom_map: Map atoms from left pyridine through left imine, central guanidine, right imine, right pyridine in SMILES order.

molecules.label: E,E-PyDIG conjugate acid
molecules.protonation: singly protonated PyDIG conjugate acid; proton is on the central guanidine imine nitrogen shown as [NH2+]
molecules.atom_map: Use the same atom-map convention as EE_neutral; the added proton is unmapped.

molecules.label: Z,Z-PyDIG conjugate acid
molecules.protonation: singly protonated PyDIG conjugate acid; proton is on the central guanidine imine nitrogen shown as [NH2+]
molecules.atom_map: Use the same atom-map convention as ZZ_neutral; the added proton is unmapped.

calculation_boundary: The Agent may generate 3-D conformers from these connectivity records. No transition state, selected conformer, ranking or reference energy is supplied. Treat the two equivalent deprotonation sites consistently and disclose the convention.
